item.title: Australia: Victoria Digital Birth Certificate Pilot Enhances Family Services
item.description: Victoria has begun a trial allowing parents in three councils to securely access and store their child’s birth certificate digitally via the Service Victoria app, simplifying administrative processes

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Innovation Powers Growth in Publishing Sector
item.description: Vietnam’s publishing industry is embracing digital transformation in 2026, leveraging e-books, AI and multimedia to modernise production, expand readership and strengthen global competitiveness.

item.title: Singapore: Sustainable 3D Concrete Printing for Smarter Construction
item.description: Singapore researchers advance sustainable 3D concrete printing, significantly cutting labour, materials and emissions while accelerating digital, automated construction processes on worksites.

item.title: Malaysia: Advanced Wafer-Level Tech Boosts Chip Manufacturing
item.description: A new Penang facility expands advanced semiconductor packaging and testing capacity, supporting higher value chip manufacturing and strengthening Malaysia’s role in global supply chains.

item.title: The Philippines: SEC Digitises Business Registration for Efficiency
item.description: The SEC has fully digitised company registration and public services, offering online platforms like eSPARC, eSECURE, SEC-ZERO and iMessage to make business registration faster, more transparent and accessible.

item.title: Australia: Wearable Patch Enables Real-Time Drug Monitoring
item.description: UNSW researchers have developed a minimally invasive wearable patch that continuously monitors vancomycin levels, enabling real-time, personalised dosing and improving patient safety in hospital settings.

item.title: Indonesia: Critical Thinking Key to Navigating AI-Driven Future
item.description: Indonesia’s Deputy Minister Christie urges students to actively develop critical thinking and advanced research skills to innovate responsibly and navigate the complex challenges of an AI-driven society.

item.title: Hong Kong: PolyU Expands Technology-Focused Summer Learning
item.description: PolyU’s 2026 International Summer School and Summer Institute offer students hands-on, technology-driven learning in science, AI, sustainability and innovation, fostering global academic engagement and skills development.

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Foundations Empower Fisheries Management
item.description: Vietnam is rapidly modernising fisheries management and actively combating illegal fishing through integrated digital systems, improving transparency, sustainability and compliance across the sector.

item.title: Singapore: Operation Cyber Guardian Boosts Telecom Resilience
item.description: Singapore launched Operation Cyber Guardian, a multi-agency effort with telcos, to contain sophisticated state-linked cyberattacks and strengthen protection of critical telecommunications and essential services.
